name: velocity-marquee
title: Velocity Marquee
description: A looping marquee that drifts on its own, speeds up with scroll speed, follows scroll direction and leans (skews) while you scroll fast.

meta.reducedMotion: A static, wrapped row of the same words.
meta.useWhen: Sport, launches, events and a single line of brand words between sections.
meta.avoidWhen: Content the reader needs (prices, dates); more than one marquee per page.
